author_reduction_recommendation: The authors recommend using their cassette-dosing LC-MS/MS PK method with engineered alanine-modified IgG1 antibodies to reduce animal use and development costs while maintaining comparable PK results.

animal_arms.endpoints_unique_to_animal: t1/2, C0, AUClast, Vss after intravenous administration

nams_discussed.method: cassette-dosing pharmacokinetic evaluation combined with multiplex LC-MS/MS using alanine mutations/insertions in the IgG1 CH1 constant region
